description: Traits the player can adapt on the fermenter cell. Each trait scales supermodule parameters (<variable>_<submodule>) of the default instance by a multiplier within [min, max]. Expression traits scale how many copies of a transport protein the cell makes (density, capacity or flux-force coefficient); midpoint traits scale a half-saturation or half-activation constant of its kinetics. A cell with new traits starts at the steady state of its new parameters (its baseline). Proteins are offered only once they exist (content/protein_timeline.json). Leaks are membrane properties, not proteins, so they are not traits. An expression trait scales the transporter's own density or capacity and its copy number in protein_expression together, so more copies cost more ATP to keep; raising expression also spends the ATP to build the new copies (n L (c_syn + c_poly) / N_A), paced over expression_time_constant_s.
